referenceFunction.generalComment: The data on the technical infrastructure originates from Ammann Schweiz AG, one of the world’s leading manufacturers of mixing plants and machinery for the construction industry, with core expertise in road construction and transport infrastructure. referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The process includes the plant buildings, process technology, silos, tanks, exhaust ducts, and conveyor belts.
referenceFunction.name: Asphalt plant operation

technology.text: According to Ammann Schweiz AG, an average asphalt mixing plant has a service life of around 25 years, with an operating time of 750 h/a and an annual production of approximately 80'000 tons.

timePeriod.text: Review of data currency scheduled after 5 years.
